findings.reason: The no-feedback AWGN definition does not require a measurable decoder, and the feedback definition does not require Borel-measurable encoders. Without these conditions the error event or recursively induced law need not be defined. Specify measurability in both definitions.

Step 1.1 of def-it-two-user-real-awgn-mac-code applies thm-substitution, whose stated domain is a finite interval, to an integral over R. Apply substitution on bounded intervals and justify passage to the improper-integral limit.

The conditional bound in lem-it-finite-gaussian-mixture-entropy-bounds is stated with a scalar one-half factor for vector Y and undefined vector variance; step 5.1 instead derives a d/2 factor. State a dimensionally valid coordinatewise or trace bound.

The sharp bound in lem-it-fano-for-finite-message-density-observations assumes that an error leaves at most m-1 possible messages. The statement does not require phi to take values in the message set; specify that codomain or weaken the sharp bound.

The AWGN proofs use continuous mutual-information identities and chain rules without a declared supplier or density derivation: thm-it-two-user-real-awgn-mac-capacity-region steps 1.2–3.2; lem-it-ozarow-feedback-sum-corner-achievable steps 5.1–6.1; lem-it-awgn-feedback-rate-splitting-achievable step 5.1; and thm-it-ozarow-awgn-mac-feedback-capacity-region steps 1.1–5.1. The Gaussian variance-ratio and posterior-variance identities also need justification. Add direct density calculations locally; the generic standard-Borel supplier carries an AC premise that these items do not claim.

The unique-threshold decoding rules do not specify a total output when no candidate or multiple candidates pass. Add a fixed default and tie rule in thm-it-cover-leung-feedback-mac-inner-bound, thm-it-two-user-real-awgn-mac-capacity-region, thm-it-two-user-discrete-memoryless-mac-capacity-region, thm-it-physically-degraded-dm-broadcast-capacity-region, thm-it-cover-el-gamal-salehi-correlated-source-mac-sufficient-condition, and lem-it-awgn-feedback-rate-splitting-achievable.

The overview on multiuser-channel-networks says error means average joint message error, but the correlated-source coding claim defines joint source-block error. Distinguish the channel-message and source-block error conventions.
